notes.title: v1.0.7 Patch - QOL Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Patch 1.0.7 is live NOW on Steam and it includes some new QOL updates, adjustments, bug fixes, and accessibility options. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/ca5befcbf1c8e304f39b3c8e7d5ba10fadca085a.gif

Updates:

 By raising each towns' Maintenance levels, you can purchase new Village Storage upgrades in the shops, allowing you to stack more resources
 You can also purchasing upgrades for Concord's resource inventory after raising town Maintenance levels, allowing resource stacking in their backpack

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/fd26f176ad872d9499f7465ff737fe5f34050204.gif

Here's what else is new in v1.0.7:

 Added 4 new cosmetic hats - One new hat per village, and you will automatically get Spring Hamlet's new hat!
 Backpack UI changes to match the cosmetic you have equipped
 Added the ability to use Dew Jars from the Hotbar
 Adjusted boss balance (including a nerf for Bookworm)
 Adjusted tool hitboxes - Pick, Sickle, Parasol all have new adjustment behaviors and do not interrupt movement as harshly
 Adjusted some Memory wording and functionality for clarity
 Fixed issue where Rose's favor was not completing properly
 Fixed issue where "Life Moves Slowly" memory was not functioning properly
 Fixed an infinite leaflets exploit
 Minor UI adjustments
 Miscellaneous script adjustments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/aeaaba164849317f26380c93e98788f3b8fcb8b8.gif

More Accessibility Options!

 Added accessibility option to change dialogue text effect in Options menu
 Added accessibility option to remove timed elements of Waterlog Dungeon puzzles in Options menu
 Added accessibility option to influence VFX for weather elements
 Added accessibility option to influence lighting for time of day

Many of these updates were requested throughout Steam Community, Discord, Twitter, and Reddit. We read your comments every single day - so thank you for helping us improve the game!
That's all for now, but keep an eye out for more updates and news coming soon. 

Happy exploring!

(Switch Users - This patch will be available for Switch soon. As always, thank you so much for your patience!)

notes.title: A New Character + Song Reveal
notes.content:
Before we leave for the holidays, we wanted to introduce you to another citizen of the Grove, share a new song, as well as celebrate our fundraiser for No Kid Hungry!


👋Introducing Plum

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/bffce7fd4f15c2f836e906f5b2591b9bb43b63ee.gif

You’ve heard about Concord and how they’re stepping into the role of Guardian for their community, but do you ever wonder who will teach them what that entails? 

Rana and Elderberry -- along with other helpers like Fuji and Maraschino -- will absolutely assist Concord, but in addition to neighbors and friends, there are other guardians! Introducing Concord's mentor: Plum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/be10a7e54a768a2c3b134360b7ad56d3614f6248.gif

Concord wishes they could spend more time with Plum, but for now, Plum's days are filled with learning more about the increasing Rot, and town repairs must take precedence!


Get Your Headphones Ready 🎧

As a little bonus, we also wanted to share a brand-new song from an area we haven’t shown very much of so far: Winter Glade. 

Like Autumn Town and Summer Bar, Winter Glade has also found itself disconnected and in a state of disrepair. 

To accompany the new track from our wonderful composer, Grahm Nesbitt, we also have the first ever peek at Winter Glade’s library and its mayor, Ledidi. We hope you enjoy it! 

[previewyoutube=bhK0zll_XAY;full][/previewyoutube] 


🎉 Fundraiser Success

Thanks to everyone’s help and generosity, the fundraiser for No Kid Hungry was a roaring success: we surpassed our initial goal of $300 to raise a whopping $560.42! YAY!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/bf8e6c2da2a1920e497ffb867c68deca75412f26.png

Because we made it beyond our stretch goal, we’ve got a special celebratory stream to kick off the new year! 

On Wednesday, January 6th starting at 3 PM PDT, the Garden Story and Rose City Games team will be playing Among Us. Tune in on Twitch to see who’s the most suspicious on our team…


 Happy Holidays 💜

2020 has been a challenging year in so many ways, but being able to develop Garden Story and interact with all of you has kept our spirits up -- whether on social media, in Discord, and now in our livestreams. 

As always, please let us know if you have any questions about Garden Story.
We’ll see you in the new year!

💖 Jenny & the Garden Story team

notes.title: Garden Story Fundraiser for No Kid Hungry
notes.content:
A core belief of the Garden Story team is that a sense of community is central to our well-being, and that positive and impactful actions we take within our communities can help them thrive. We’re proud to announce one action we’re taking is to fundraise for No Kid Hungry throughout the month of December!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/bf8e6c2da2a1920e497ffb867c68deca75412f26.png

No Kid Hungry provides food to kids through free meal programs and food skills education to families. Whether it’s supporting kids through free meals during the summer or providing food education for families: we appreciate No Kid Hungry’s mission, and we think the fruits, veggies, and fungi of the Grove would too! 

We also won’t be fundraising alone! We're teaming up with Streamline Media Group, and the No Kid Hungry ambassador streamers to showcase a bevvy of food-focused and family-friendly indie titles throughout the month of December! Every dollar donated is the equivalent of supporting a kid for 10 meals. We'd love it if you could join us, whether it's helping spread the word, hanging out in the stream, or through a financial contribution! 


Kicking Things Off: Giving Tuesday (December 2nd)

Giving Tuesday (Dec 01st) is the first day of our fundraising festivities, and you can find all of the fun on Twitch!

The celebration will begin at 3 PM PDT when we play the adorable demo for Toasty, a charming game that’s currently in development, and then putting our match-3 fighting skills to the test with some Battle Chef Brigade!

At 5:30 PM PDT, we’ll join the wonderful ladies of GPTV on their channel as they play the Garden Story demo! You’ll definitely want to tune in: in addition to playing the demo, there will be some fun giveaways. (Stickers, anyone?) 

The fun doesn’t stop when Giving Tuesday is done!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/609a23ac73760c9f8aac2352c6e5dbd481b9a15c.png

For the following three Wednesdays (Dec 2,9, and 16), we’ll be bringing back the weekly Rose City Games' livestreams and showcasing even more indies as we continue our fundraising efforts. 

In keeping with the theme, we’ll be playing indie game demos and released titles that all have to do with food and community ~ be sure to follow us on Twitch to get the notifications when we’re live, and see what games we have in store! (Psssst! There will also be giveaways of the released games that we're playing! You don't wanna miss it!) 

If you’re wanting -- and able -- to support our fundraising, feel free to use this link to donate and help us meet our channel goal of $300! 


Talk soon!

We'll be back with lots of fun updates on what’s been going on in the Grove! As always, please don’t hesitate to let us know if you have any questions about Garden Story: we’ll do our best to answer them! 

Cheers,

🌱Jenny + the Garden Story Team

notes.title: Last Chance to Play the Garden Story Demo!
notes.content:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/4c9c41186f08f4e2699ff987be88198bfcc32d04.jpg

The feedback and reception you’ve provided throughout the demo’s availability has helped us make the game even better, and we can’t wait for you to play the final result! Be sure to follow us here and on Twitter for all the latest news and updates on the game

Jenny & the Garden Story Team

notes.title: Garden Story Fan Art Contest Kick Off!
notes.content:
August was a BIG month of announcements, so we wanted to celebrate with a fan art contest!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/b192d1543dc8dcc515b684af460d06263917632d.png

Create any artwork you’d like related to Garden Story and the world of the Grove. Doodles, mini-comics, digital paintings, 3D models, or coffee mugs painted with fruity friends: the opportunities to showcase your creativity are endless! 

Share an image of your creation with us on Twitter for a chance to win some wonderful Garden Story prizes. 

No purchase necessary. Official rules apply. See our official page for all the details. 

---------------------------------------------------------------

Entry Period: 

Tuesday, September 8th, 2020 - Wednesday, September 30th, 2020

---------------------------------------------------------------

Categories + Prizes:

Overall Selection: The creation that takes the cake and makes our hearts go pitter-patter! Will it be yours? 

Single Character Piece: You focused on highlighting one character, and we love that! Concord, Rana, Elderberry, Hakurei… there’s a whole neighborhood of friendly fruits, frogs, and fungi to pick from.

Group Piece: Life is more fun with friends, and you wanted to feature more than just one! This category is for works that include two or more characters from Garden Story. 

There will be at least three (3) winners selected, one for each category. Each winner will receive a prize of a digital Garden Story game key (upon release of the full game), Garden Story sticker sheet, Concord pin, and a postcard!

Note: In addition to these main categories, we may select additional pieces we enjoy to win prizes, dependent on the number of entries! ^_^

---------------------------------------------------------------

Again, full entry details, requirements, and stipulations are all located on our main contest page, so be sure to read up! Feel free to send me a message on Twitter via the Garden Story account or email me if you have any questions. 

Have a great time creating your art! We can't wait to see what you come up with!

💚 Jenny + the Garden Story team

 Jenny and Will will be providing a live tour of the Garden Story booth and playing the demo, and they -- along with Picogram and other members of the Garden Story/Rose City Games team -- will be in chat, hanging out, and answering questions. Ask about the game dev process, what Pico likes to listen to while working, or even what games we’re also excited to try out during the IAB event. We can’t wait to say hi!


Saturday, August 29 @ 10 AM PST - 12 PM PST -- Livestreams of the Demo w/ MerryKish and ZaxelZach!


 Watch as these two incredible streamers each play the Garden Story demo for the first time LIVE on our Steam page! MerryKish  will be playing from 10 AM - 11 AM PST, and ZaxelZach  will be jumping in from 11 AM PST - 12 PM PST. (Psst: both streamers have never witnessed the incredible girthy, monolithic form of Calabasa… wonder if they’ll going to discover where Calabasa’s hiding during the stream? ;) Better watch and see!) 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/3bf82df6d0cf396d1f6e73f0d210cc3a8791f762.gif

Win a Pin!

Want a Concord of your very own? This weekend, that dream could be made into reality! 
We’ll be hosting a giveaway (with MULTIPLE winners) for you to have a chance at winning an adorable Concord pin. Keep an eye out for the tweet that’ll tell you exactly what you need to do to enter (or just hang out in our Discord!)

WHEW!

notes.title: Garden Story: July Recap
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/4f4a6148a8a23873d35b16d7f8b6359ed5a94708.gif

July is already done (whaaaa?), which means it’s time for a Garden Story update! A lot of time is being spent on larger systems, like how you’ll be working with other members of the Grove, as well as different objects and tasks for helping make your world a better place. 

We’ll share more details when we are able, but until then, here are some additional smaller updates that will hopefully whet your appetite! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Glomp glomp!

What’s this? A new, dangerous rot has been spotted! Bigger than the average Rot, these Glomps are known to come out at night, and get a bit agitated if you get close, so be careful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/c6072aa0a411dadeeb8e841b3528f476ebbcdaf6.gif

Stay Hydrated

While the original jar was a grape idea (huhuu~), this new health bar will hopefully add more clarity to how much health Concord has while exploring, and when it’s time for a pit stop for more dew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/3e6ed7f6660f0f62c51ce847b576d76694fb9e2b.gif

Splashy Rot

This Acorn Rot was getting a bit too rambunctious, so we had to tone its rot splashes down a bit ~ here’s how it looks now! Be sure to use that dodge roll to provide some quick distance between Concord and their clouds. Pico’s also exploring damage counters for when you’re wacking things with your pick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/00c5fefc50f3631dca230a409aee5cad5c8b5b77.gif

Take Off your Shoes, and Enjoy!

Ever just want to walk through some soft grass? The lushness of The Grove has been intensified with the addition of more squishy foliage to walk through ~ ahhh, so refreshing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/566ca4b1cf9774cc9fb2d3a8e26bda5333bb2498.gif

Summer of Games? Summer of GRAPES!

Concord was invited to hang with a bunch of other wonderful indies during the Twitch Indie Discovery Show last week! Jenny (Communications Manager) got to share with the Twitch community the joys of fruit puns, as well as provide a reminder that the Garden Story demo IS available here on Steam if you’d like to try it out (or share with friends!) 

Watch the VOD at this link (Garden Story is around the 2 hour 35 min mark): https://www.twitch.tv/videos/693490220

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/8f629ea50af2b372e1c24a590fba67f08541f61a.gif

Inviting you to our Indie Arena Booth!

In just a few short weeks, the Indie Arena Booth will be open! This’ll be your chance to see more indie games, Garden Story included. We’ll be running a few live events for you all to participate in, and will be posting more about that in the coming weeks! For now? The best place you’ll be able to get the insider scoop for what’s going to happen is in our Discord, so be sure to join if you want to know more. 

[previewyoutube=p55uCmjxmWI;full][/previewyoutube]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We’ll keep you posted, so, again, please consider joining our Discord, subscribing to our newsletter, or following us on Twitter! Tomorrow, we’ll be releasing a newsletter that dives a bit more into the Library system (and sharing a taste of some Garden Story lore, so you don’t want to miss it! -- subscribe here).

Talk soon, 

💜 Jenny + The Garden Story team

notes.title: Garden Story Release Update + June Refresh
notes.content:
We’re so excited to announce a new partnership with Kowloon Nights, who are helping us bring Garden Story to fruition! If you haven’t heard, Kowloon Nights is a video game fund that focuses on backing independent developers. They’ve helped fund other cozy and wholesome titles you may be familiar with, and you can check them out here. Their support will allow us to expand the world, making the game bigger, better, and more delightful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/71284a722c97743035771cf61711438f8d3f5aac.png

You can expect more fruity friends who’ll provide additional favors and requests to hone your skills and foster the Grove’s community; a wider variety of Rot types and bosses to combat; additional natural resources to collect and further unlock the history of The Grove… and a few more surprises to make Garden Story the very best it can be. Because the team is working hard to expand Garden Story, we will also need more time than originally planned. The game will no longer be launching in Spring 2020 - we are now planning on releasing in 2021, and will let you know more details as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience, and promise it will be worth it! 

None of this would be possible without our amazing community. You uplift, inspire, and motivate us with your messages and comments as we continue to create Garden Story. So we wanted to say THANK YOU for supporting the team!  

If you’re curious to see more, we’ve refreshed our Steam page where you can see some of the updates and new content we’ve been working on; we can’t wait to hear what you think. One of the new additions? This updated teaser trailer!

[previewyoutube=ni0Phd7xH8Y;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have any additional questions not answered here, please feel free to find us on Discord or email us at hello@rosecitygames.com! 

Thanks, and talk soon!

Rose City Games + Picogram

notes.title: Garden Story May Recap
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/fe02a1f4322ff54eaa369f262f59774a4b3041e1.gif

Happy Friday everyone! Time to end the week with your dose of Vitamin C...oncord! Eh? Ehh? ^_^ Okay, before I show myself out, let me first preview what Pico and the team have been hard at work with on Garden Story!

Do the Dew
How do we know what’s in a jar? Why, by labeling it, of course! Visual indicators have been added to jars so you can identify what type of dew it stores!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/1281fae1a7d44fe5f628c779738cb8e654903f4b.gif

You Are Here
Still getting your bearings? Not only does the map showcase the name and coordinates of each area, but there’s a handy Concord pin now to show you where they are!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/44d6d040e3011d44efd5ec28bd9d1a2435ec6248.gif

Updated Pick Combat
The pick art has more detail and the animation packs a little bit more punch, so thwacking Rot feels more impactful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/8168005d747c8855e84179486028020d17f35cb6.gif

Extra Extra!
You can know it’s time to read new posts on the request board when you see this handy bobbling sign above it. In addition to these, there are general indicators above areas of interest as well, so you have an idea of where to explore if you’re stuck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/c952148572ff6d3a9c1b675cc3f59f88d1d7f28f.gif

Story Bits & Squashing Bugs
In addition to visual tweaks and improvements, we’ve also been really dialing in the story and fixing bugs that have cropped up! It’s harder to show that type of progress, but we can say that we’re really proud of how it’s coming along, and can’t wait to reveal more of what this world is like (and what’s happening to it!) In the meantime? Here’s a gif of Concord hanging out with some fellow Spring Hamlet neighbors and enjoying a lovely rainy day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/a4e7b25c2b1618ceebfb37414dd98dad340ea01a.gif

The Wholesome Direct
Finally, we were featured as a part of the first ever Wholesome Direct! It was an incredible experience seeing all of these indie games come together in an event that celebrated cozy vibes and kindness. Missed it? Don’t worry! The full video is available here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/37f771f6c977a58b284b46a1357dd7cfaad68c1f.gif

We’ll be participating in even more events in the coming months and have a few fun activities of our own up our sleeve, so be sure to pop into our Discord or follow us on Twitter to hear all about them as we share the announcements! 

Talk soon!

Jenny and the Garden Story Team

notes.title: LudoNarraCon Begins 💛
notes.content:
LudoNarraCon is here! 

We’ve been recording, prepping, coding, testing, and gathering lots of behind-the-scenes and special content to stream all weekend for the second year of LudoNarraCon, a digital event hosted by the awesome folks of Fellow Traveler. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/7991be0ec387d7d54c1a918259897c2350e9250e.png

If you haven’t gotten to participate in LudoNarraCon before, you’re in for a treat. All weekend, there will be panels, streams, and demos to check out, all united by the fact that they celebrate games with a focus on narrative. We’re so happy that Garden Story gets to be a part of the festivities, and wanted to let you know what you can expect throughout the weekend!

Garden Story Broadcasting

Starting Friday at 10 AM PST, we’ll also be showcasing a wide variety of content on our main Steam page! Our broadcast will loop throughout the entire weekend (the event ends on Monday, April 27th at 11:50 PM PST), so please feel free to visit our page for: 
 Pixel art with Picogram, lead developer and artist for Garden Story
 Tiny Jams: mini one-song shows performed by Grahm Nesbitt, composer for Garden Story
 Demo gameplay with Rose City Games co-founders, Will Lewis and Corey Warning, and community dev, Jenny Windom
 ...and more!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/bddd53aa1cac39b28a0842066d28b8050f5f9584.gif

The Autumn Town Demo Returns (Permanently!) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/d9e32b8e9ed9138ccedb0f56a7f74f52c25f3d81.gif

We’ve fixed the lift up to Autumn Town again...and this time, it’s indefinite! What was previously a limited-time demo will now be available to play even after LudoNarraCon has finished. 

Folks who have tried the demo previously offered up lots of great feedback, and we’re happy to share an updated build with lots of tweaks and fixes. This means that while it’s still a standalone experience, it will more closely resemble what you can expect in the final version of the game. Some of these updates include: 
 Making sure everything’s pixel-perfect by cleaning up animation frames, extra text in places it shouldn’t be, and setting fences in exactly the right spot!
 Created a toggle-able “Non-perish mode” so you can live life as a grape on the edge ~ or keep it cozy and not have to worry.
 Looking fancy and fresh: we’ve updated map and menu UI so you can better track your progress 
 Stay organized: you can now drop items you don’t need and collected items won’t disappear if your inventory is already full!
 Touched up and clarified the main mission and requests
 Finessed button remapping 
 Oh, and...the stump enemy has a surprise in store for you. 😎


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/8fa05053e74a5bc093c24a4c3f7d8eaae232f705.gif

Join the Community 

If you’re as excited about Garden Story as we are, please join in the fun in our Discord or follow us on Twitter. We’d love to say hi, hear what you think of the game, and able to share some exciting news with you in the future. :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/1f2019ec0147be84c05188e7afcfcdf772138af0.gif

Cheers, and we hope you enjoy LudoNarraCon and the Garden Story demo!

💚 Jenny and the Garden Story Team

notes.title: Garden Story joins LudoNarraCon 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/b837f7ec461143374376bf5c33e0e12a9c8fe019.gif
The sun is shining here in Portland, and while we’ve been enjoying the newfound warm weather (all while practicing social distancing, of course), we’ve also been working on Garden Story! There are lots of game updates to share with you soon, but first, BIG news on the event front: Garden Story is a part of LudoNarraCon 2020!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/e6b9d3ded83c69b6443ef110dc5e906c0de6ce24.gif

What’s LudoNarraCon? 
If you don’t know about this event, hold onto your computer! LudoNarraCon is a chance for folks who love narrative games to get a peek into what’s new and on the way, all from the comfort of their homes: it's 100% digital.

From April 24th - 27th (next weekend!), you’ll be able to visit Garden Story’s Steam page and: 
  Download and play the Autumn Town Demo!
 Watch behind-the-scenes footage of Picogram creating the pixel art and discussing narrative and design.
 Listen to performances by composer and sound designer, Grahm Nessbit.
 Hang out with the team as they play through Garden Story. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/3eecbf9ed939be41bf8cc2ad82c3f17eb0691992.png

Tune In And Enjoy!
All of this will be looping throughout the weekend, so there’s plenty of chances to tune in, experience Garden Story, and enjoy the festivities at your leisure by stopping by the Garden Story Steam page. You can also follow us on Twitter to get updates on the schedule and what you can expect to see next! 

LudoNarraCon will also be on Steam’s front page with panels all about narrative games, a huge sale to splurge on, and lots of demos to play - so be sure to check the rest of the event out! Check out their latest news update for ALL the details on exhibitors, panels, games on sale, and more. 

There are TONS of demos we’re personally excited to jump into, like Boyfriend Dungeon (Kitfox Games), Welcome to Elk (Triple Topping), Solace State (Vivid Foundry Corp.), Yes Your Grace (No More Robots), She Dreams Elsewhere (Studio Zevere), and more. We’re pretty sure your weekend’ll be packed if you try to get to them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/9ee810f75a931f916d4be03fc6f50d51091c2825.gif

See You There!
If you’re as excited about LudoNarraCon as we are, let us know! You can hop into our Discord to chat with other people excited about Garden Story, including us, the team behind its development. We’ll also likely be gushing about all the demos we’re trying out, and we’d love to hear what you’re playing too.

We’ll have more updates about the game coming soon, so stay tuned. And we hope to see you during LudoNarraCon!

💚 Jenny, Picogram, and the Garden Story Team

notes.title: Keybinding Options Now Available!
notes.content:
Oi! First off, thanks so much for checking out the Autumn Town Demo! To address one of the biggest points of feedback, we're introducing keybinding options in the latest build! Now you can assign keyboard controls pretty much any way you want.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/f92d940f948bebb18724b9b0ae1542eab148657b.png

This latest patch also addresses a handful of minor bugs, improvements to the options menu UI, and auto-detection for controllers. A quick heads up: unless any new show-stopper issues arise, the demo will not be updated further. This will allow us to turn our focus back to the main game and stay on schedule. Please keep that good, good feedback coming our way so we can take it into consideration during the rest of Garden Story's development!

Remember, the Autumn Town Demo is only available until December 21st, 2019. If you haven't downloaded it yet, make sure to grab it before it's gone... and tell a friend or two if you get a chance. It super helps us out! ^_^

- Pico + Rose City Games


P.S. If you enjoyed the demo, don't forget to add Garden Story to your Wishlist!
